collection.title: Crumb Catcher Bibs
collection.body_html:
Crumb Catcher Bibs

Crumb catcher bibs feature an integrated pocket or tray designed to catch food spills, crumbs, and liquids during mealtime. These bibs reduce cleanup time and keep floors cleaner while babies and toddlers learn to self-feed.

Materials and Construction

Available in food-grade silicone, waterproof fabric, and hybrid designs. Silicone options offer rigid pockets that stay open, while fabric versions with stiffened catchers provide flexibility and packability. BPA-free, phthalate-free materials ensure safety for daily use.

Features

Deep front pockets capture dropped food and prevent spills from reaching clothing and floors. Adjustable neck closures accommodate growing children from 6 months through toddler years. Waterproof backing protects clothing from liquids and stains. Easy-wipe surfaces and dishwasher-safe construction simplify cleaning between meals.

Sizing and Fit

Most crumb catcher bibs feature adjustable closures with multiple snap or clasp positions. Standard sizing fits children from weaning age through 3+ years. Check neck circumference measurements and pocket depth to ensure adequate coverage and catching capacity.
